images.brief:
Create ONE original photorealistic-natural food illustration for a NutriFit Vietnamese recipe card: Cơm cá kho.
Follow this exact preparation description: Làm sốt gừng/hành/tỏi/mắm/đường với dầu/nước; kho nhanh cá chín và chia sốt vào suất; ăn cùng cơm/dưa..
The actual recipe includes only these ingredients: Cơm trắng gạo tẻ đã nấu, không dầu; Thịt cá lóc hấp chín, bỏ xương, không dầu/sốt; Gừng tươi sống, gọt vỏ; Tỏi ta sống, bóc vỏ; Hành tím sống, bóc vỏ; Nước mắm nguyên chất; Đường trắng tinh luyện; Dầu đậu nành tinh luyện; Nước lọc dùng trong món; Hành lá sống; Dưa leo sống, giữ vỏ ăn được; Tiêu đen xay khô.
Show one realistic Vietnamese serving, visually appropriate cooked components and herbs. When the name starts with Cơm, include a separate modest mound of steamed white rice alongside the named main dish; for soup plus rice show soup bowl and rice bowl together. Do not turn Vietnamese rice-and-main-dish meals into Western bowls or add unlisted sausages, fried eggs or meat. Do not add pork to chicken-only or tofu dishes. Respect the named protein and cooking method.
Food centered on plain ceramic tableware, warm natural daylight on a light wooden table, appetizing editorial food photography style, horizontal 16:9 composition with the full plate/bowl visible. No people, no text, no labels, no branding, no watermark. This is an original generated illustration, not an existing restaurant photograph. Suitable for an 800x450 recipe-card display.
